desc:
🦇 Born human. Choose what you become.

You wake in Ashfall, a town at the edge of a valley at war. The lamps are going dark, and something is whispering in the trees.

Turn Vampire, Werewolf or Mage, or take up the stake and hunt them all. Explore the valley, follow your path's questline and fight your way up the tiers.

⚔️ Knock enemies down, then grip them to finish the fight
🧬 Every path splits into variants, each with its own signature move
🎒 Loot gear from scraps to Legendary (trading soon)
🩸 Build your bloodline or raise your own faction
🌕 Blood Moons, Full Moons and rifts that tear open at night

📱 PC, mobile and console

👍 4000 LIKES = a new code in our community server
👥 Join the group for +5% XP
🔔 Favorite and hit Notify for updates
